description: This file defines configurations and utility classes for the Azure AI Studio integration within the litellm project. It handles URL construction, environment validation, message transformation, request and response transformation, error handling, and model support checks specific to Azure AI Studio, extending base classes and utilizing utility functions to facilitate communication with Azure's OpenAI-compatible APIs.

classes.name: AzureFoundryErrorStrings
classes.description: An enumeration of specific error strings related to Azure Foundry configuration errors.

classes.name: AzureAIStudioConfig
classes.description: A configuration class extending OpenAIConfig with methods tailored for Azure AI Studio, including URL construction, environment validation, message transformation, error handling, and support determination for Azure-specific models.

methods.name: List get_supported_openai_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns the list of supported OpenAI parameters, filtering out 'tool_choice' if the model doesn't support it.

methods.name: bool _supports_stop_reason(self, model: str)
methods.description: Determines if a model supports stop tokens, with special handling for 'grok' models.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Validates and sets appropriate headers for Azure AI Studio environment based on URL and API key.

methods.name: bool _should_use_api_key_header(self, api_base: str)
methods.description: Checks if the 'api-key' header should be used based on the API base URL host.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, stream: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for Azure AI Studio, appending path and query parameters.

methods.name: List[ProviderField] get_required_params(self)
methods.description: Returns the required parameters for the provider: API key and base URL.

methods.name: List _transform_messages( self, messages: List[AllMessageValues], model: str, )
methods.description: Transforms message content by converting list contents to string unless message contains audio or images.

methods.name: bool _is_azure_openai_model(self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str])
methods.description: Checks if a model is an Azure OpenAI model based on its name and available model lists.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[str],Optional[str],str] _get_openai_compatible_provider_info( self, model: str, api_base: Optional[str], api_key: Optional[str], custom_llm_provider: str, )
methods.description: Determines and returns API base URL, API key, and provider info for Azure OpenAI models.

methods.name: dict transform_request( self, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Augments or modifies outgoing request data, especially handling extra body content.

methods.name: ModelResponse transform_response( self, model: str, raw_response: Response, model_response: ModelResponse, logging_obj: LiteLLMLoggingObj, request_data: dict, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, encoding: Any, api_key: Optional[str] = None, json_mode: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Processes raw responses, tagging model name with 'azure_ai/'.

methods.name: bool should_retry_llm_api_inside_llm_translation_on_http_error( self, e: httpx.HTTPStatusError, litellm_params: dict )
methods.description: Determines whether to retry on specific HTTP errors based on error message contents.

methods.name: int max_retry_on_unprocessable_entity_error(self)
methods.description: Returns the maximum retry count for 422 errors.

methods.name: dict transform_request_on_unprocessable_entity_error(self, e: httpx.HTTPStatusError, request_data: dict)
methods.description: Adjusts the request data in case of 422 errors, possibly removing invalid parameters.

methods.name: dict _drop_extra_params_from_request_data(self, request_data: dict, error_text: str)
methods.description: Removes specific parameters from the request data based on error details.

methods.name: Optional[List[str]] _extract_params_to_drop_from_error_text(self, error_text: str)
methods.description: Extracts parameter names that need to be dropped based on the error message text.
